strings.title: YumeShelf
strings.setting_auto_allow_large_saves_info: Very large save files can take longer to open and use more memory while editing.
strings.setting_max_depth_info: How many subfolder levels deep YumeShelf searches for games. Increase this if your games are inside nested folders (higher numbers take longer to scan).
strings.setting_location_display_info: Choose whether game cards show only the parent folder name or the full folder path.
strings.setting_title_display_info: Choose whether cards show the game's detected title or the exact folder name on your drive.
strings.setting_product_codes_info: Show store catalog codes (like RJ or VJ) on game cards when found in the folder name.
strings.setting_expose_beta_info: Show experimental features that are still in development and may be incomplete or change later.
strings.welcome_desc: Choose how you want to organize your library.
strings.installer_shell_intro_title: Install YumeShelf with the same feel as the app itself.
strings.installer_shell_intro_copy: We will keep this short: confirm where the app lives, then jump straight into YumeShelf.
strings.installer_shell_intro_point_path: Choose the app folder with File Explorer.
strings.installer_shell_intro_point_theme: Follow your system light or dark theme automatically.
strings.installer_shell_intro_point_speed: Finish quickly, then continue in YumeShelf's normal welcome setup.
strings.installer_shell_path_copy: This location is only for the YumeShelf app files.
strings.installer_shell_path_note: This does not affect the game library location you will choose later in YumeShelf's welcome setup.
strings.installer_shell_path_notice: Will not affect your game folder path.
strings.installer_shell_delete_setup: Remove this setup file after YumeShelf launches

strings.about_tagline: A minimalist game library and launcher for your personal collection.
strings.about_author: Created by loerei
strings.about_credits_intro: YumeShelf and YumeEngine are built on open-source tools and research from the community:
strings.about_credit_die_desc: Binary inspection heuristics, PE structure analysis, and engine signatures.
strings.about_credit_xunity_desc: Unity runtime translation architecture and plugin hooking models.
strings.about_credit_bepinex_desc: Unity and .NET modding and runtime injection framework.
strings.about_license_text: YumeShelf is free and open-source software under the MIT License.
